prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a hit while turning left. The patient had 3 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1359; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck on the driver side while turning left. The patient reports bracing with an outstretched hand at impact and presented with pain, swelling, and limited motion of the right wrist. Radiographs confirmed a distal radius fracture, and examination findings were consistent with the imaging. The mechanism of injury and the force described are in keeping with this type of fracture. No prior injury or treatment to the same area is known to this provider. Care was provided across three visits, consisting of immobilization, pain management, and follow-up imaging, with a typical recovery course. Symptoms and range of motion improved steadily, and treatment was tapered as the patient progressed. Billing records for this episode are currently under routine review for duplicate entries.
